evaluation: 2015-2024 retrospective; selection and tuning confined to prior realized labels
label: VWAP(t+2)/VWAP(t+1)-1; both endpoint quality ok_hfq; predict cross-sectional rank, evaluate against RAW return
selection: rolling3years daily PearsonIC; coverage>=80%, ICvalid>=80% training sessions; absolute meanIC order; direction from same training fold
correlation: prioritize representatives with abs mean daily rank correlation <0.90; backfill by absoluteIC to exactly100 if needed; log backfill
inner_validation: last20% historical dates; purge exit>=validation start; separate inner factor selection; final outer refit reselects100
training: sample every fifth date, ALL eligible stocks on selected dates; daily prediction; quarterly refit
tuning: 2 preset configurations/model except equalweight; pick mean validation RankIC; neural8epochs; no evaluation-period choices
inputs: 100 signed processed factors plus100 missing flags; 2 common market-state variables for all learned models; equalweight only100 factors
missing: at least50 factors available; train median then train scale; no future label filter on prediction rows
moe: three small neural experts; softmax gate on lag-free close-known20d index momentum and volatility; descriptive comparator not claimed novel
primary_metrics: daily PearsonIC and SpearmanRankIC against raw1d return; HAC and paired equalweight differences; no portfolio returns in this experiment
limits: historical sample already viewed; covariance redundancy not independence; fixed100 may include correlated backfill
